//============================ binary

// binary 0
begin_should_be_0
0
0_
0_0
00000000_00000000
00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000
end_should_be_0

// binary 1
begin_should_be_1
1
1_
01
0_1
00000000_00000001
00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000001
end_should_be_1

// binary 2
begin_should_be_2
10
10_
1_0
00000000_00000010
00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000010
end_should_be_2

// binary 2^62
should_be_pow2_62
01000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000

// binary 2^63 - 1
should_be_pow2_63_minus_1_AKA_i64_MAX
01111111_11111111_11111111_11111111__11111111_11111111_11111111_11111111

// binary 2^63
should_be_pow2_63
10000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000

// binary 2^64 - 1
should_be_pow2_64_minus_1
11111111_11111111_11111111_11111111__11111111_11111111_11111111_11111111

// binary 2^64
should_be_pow2_64
1__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000__00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000
